links.outcome: Consistency of synthetic CTA performance across internal and four external validation sets
links.effect: Performance remained consistent across four external validation sets; internal validation MAE 0.0416, MSE 0.0178, PSNR 25.59 dB, SSIM 85.41%.
links.quote: Performance remained consistent across four external validation sets.

unlisted_practices: Synthetic CTA generation from non-contrast CT for screening/triage
Comparison of generative model against five baseline image-synthesis models on quantitative metrics

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an AI model for synthesizing CT angiography from non-contrast CT, including reader evaluation by clinicians on retrospective data, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
